subject: MSA + Order Form: Ariba activation preflight & vendor details
messages:
From: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@terranovahealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: ariba-admin@terranovahealth.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding + MSA redlines for Ariba activation

Hi Soojin / Kimberly,

Attached are TerraNova's redlines to the MSA and our preferred order form template. We're aiming to complete legal review and have the vendor created in Ariba this week so we can start accepting POs for the pilot (PO prefix TN-REDWOOD). A few items for coordination: 

- Please confirm whether Redwood requires a specific vendor code format in Ariba (we typically use numeric vendor IDs).
- Our Ariba team (ariba-admin) needs any tax ID / remit address you expect to appear on the PO for validation.
- We saw a proposed indemnity tweak in section 8 — Kevin (cc'd) will include legal comments but flagged that data retention and subprocessor language may need a carveout for telemetry.

Attachments: TerraNova_MSA_redline_v1.pdf (pdf), OrderForm_TerraNova.xlsx (xlsx)

Next steps: can someone from Redwood (ops/legal) propose a small set of edits we can route to Kevin for signoff? Also let us know if you want to use API or SFTP for PO notifications — ariba-admin prefers SFTP for now.

Thanks,
Alice Bennett
Director, Strategic Sourcing
TerraNova Health

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@terranovahealth.com>, ariba-admin@terranovahealth.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redlines for Ariba activation

Hi Alice — thanks for the materials; appreciated. Looping in Marissa from legal and Kimberly from vendor operations to keep the thread tight. Quick read and clarifying Qs below so we can hand off a consolidated set of edits to Kevin: 

1) Vendor identifier: Redwood's vendor creation in customer Ariba instances is flexible — we can accept either numeric or alphanumeric codes. For consistency across TerraNova's POs, could you confirm whether your procurement practice supports the PO prefix (TN-REDWOOD) as a PO number prefix vs. requiring a separate vendor site field? If you need us to set a vendor ID of "REDWOOD-TN" we can provide that.

2) Tax/Remit fields: please confirm the remit address and your EIN/TAX ID that should populate the "Bill To" block on POs. Our billing ops will validate against Ariba test POs.

3) EDI/ACK window: what is your required acknowledgement window (24/48/72 hours)? Our default SLA is 48 hours for PO acknowledgements; we can configure an EDI ACK or a manual Ack depending on your EDI partner readiness.

4) SFTP vs API: SFTP is fine for the pilot. We'll send host/key details once vendor is provisioned. If you prefer API/webhook for faster telemetry, we can discuss after initial activation.

5) MSA redlines: Marissa, I've attached Redwood's comment file (Redwood_MSA-comments.docx) with two suggested changes: narrow the telemetry/data retention carveout to "operational logs and transient caches" and add a conditional indemnity cap aligned to order form value. Kimberly, ops flagged that section on PoA/signatory matrix needs the TerraNova signature block to be consistent with your supplier portal.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA-comments.docx, Ariba-onboard-checklist.xlsx

If Kevin can return a single annotated PDF with his remaining commercial/legal asks, we can get the DocuSign envelope ready. Proposed timeline: vendor created in Ariba by EOD Fri 30 Apr, test PO on Mon 3 May. Is that workable on your side?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partnerships (Vendor Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@terranovahealth.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Kevin O'Hara <kevin.ohara@terranovahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 12:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redlines for Ariba activation

Alice / All — quick legal read below, high level:

- Section 8 (Indemnity): TerraNova's redline increases unilateral liability language. Our propose-to-counter: keep the indemnity mutual but cap per claim to a multiple of the order form value (standard practice for pilot activations). If TerraNova can accept a shorter discovery period for claims (90 days) we can be flexible.

- Data retention / telemetry: we can accept a carveout for operational logs but request an explicit maximum retention period (30 days) unless a regulated retention requirement is documented in the order form.

- Subprocessors: please confirm whether TerraNova requires subprocessors to be listed in an appendix vs. a right-to-notify model. Listing all by default in Ariba will slow onboarding; a notify-and-report cadence is preferable.

Kevin — can you confirm the indemnity cap and carveout language? If you prefer, I can produce a clean redline showing the compromise positions for faster DocuSign routing.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kevin O'Hara <kevin.ohara@terranovahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redlines for Ariba activation

Marissa / Soojin — thanks. I'm attaching an annotated PDF with our legal team's comments (TerraNova_MSA_comments_KO.pdf). Brief answers: 

- Indemnity: TerraNova prefers no cap on certain IP-related claims; however, for pilot/SMB contracts we're willing to accept a per-claim cap equal to 3x the annualized order form value. We'll mark that in the annotation and leave an optional exception for willful misconduct.

- Data retention: 90 days is our fallback for telemetry unless data is personal health information (PHI) — PHI rules will require longer retention and additional controls. If Redwood's operational logs are limited to anonymous telemetry, 30 days sounds reasonable; please ensure the order form excludes PHI processing for this engagement.

- Subprocessors: we can accept notify-and-report for initial activation, but request Redwood provide the full subprocessors list within 14 days of vendor creation.

I have prepared a DocuSign envelope for the MSA with our signature block pending your final redline. DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/MTA1-TER-msa-2027 (expires in 7 days).

Attachment: TerraNova_MSA_comments_KO.pdf

Regards,
Kevin O'Hara
Senior Counsel, TerraNova Health

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: ariba-admin@terranovahealth.com, Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@terranovahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redlines for Ariba activation

Thanks Kevin — that's helpful. Plan of record below so we can close the loop and start vendor provisioning: 

1) Marissa will produce a single compromise redline with: a) indemnity cap at 3x annualized order form value with willful misconduct carveout, b) telemetry carveout limited to "operational logs and transient caches" with 30-day retention unless PHI is explicitly included in the order form.

2) Once TerraNova approves Marissa's redline, we'll route the MSA via DocuSign (Kevin's envelope active).

3) Operational checklist for Ariba activation (attached): vendor code = REDWOOD-TN (please confirm creation), remit address = 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103, EIN = 82-1234567, PO prefix = TN-REDWOOD. Please confirm your EDI ACK SLA; otherwise we'll assume 48 hours.

4) For the pilot we'll use SFTP for PO files. Kimberly will send SFTP host/key details after vendor provisioning.

Would TerraNova's Ariba admin confirm vendor code creation and, if possible, spawn a test PO to the vendor site by COB Mon 3 May? I'll stand by for the DocuSign final and will kick off the provisioning as soon as the signed MSA is returned.

Attachments: Ariba-onboard-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partnerships (Vendor Ops)
Redwood Inference
